boards.title: Serve Reception: Rotation 1 (5-1)
boards.description:
Standard 5-1 receive formation with the setter in zone 1.

- The setter stacks just right of OH1, no deeper than the overlap needs, with a free lane to the net.
- OH2, the libero, and OH1 form the three-player receive line, left to right.
- MB1 and OPP start at the attack line, ready to approach after the serve.
- Overlap: OH1 stays right of MB1 and in front of the setter. OH2 stays left of the libero.
